purpose: Non-executing preregistration drafts; no historical execution or wrapper permission

experiments.name: Corrected-control acceptance diagnosis
experiments.objective: Attribute why eligible 2023–2025 signals fail the preserved corrected planning contract without changing qualification, risk or trade execution.
experiments.design: Read-only rejection taxonomy, per-year and per-direction counts, and provenance of all candidate and plan fields.
decisions_required: Confirm corrected reference input locks after integrity audit
Approve diagnosis categories and duplicate/overlap count semantics
Specify minimum evidentiary standard for choosing a future executable control

experiments.name: Level reaction/break plus retest
experiments.objective: Assess whether a single causal retest interaction changes accepted trade quality versus an executable frozen R7 control.
experiments.control: PENDING: approved executable control with nonzero accepted-path coverage
experiments.design: Matched control/candidate execution contract, chronological replay, stratify by setup family.
decisions_required: Exact level, reaction, break and retest definition

experiments.name: Volume/RVOL or HTF context interaction
experiments.objective: Test one predeclared causal context interaction without bundling volume and HTF changes.
experiments.candidate: PENDING: choose RVOL OR HTF as sole changed factor
experiments.design: Single-factor paired comparison with matched exits and frozen entry rules.
dependencies: EXP-032 results or justified independent baseline
decisions_required: Define causal lookback and exact cutoff/missing-bar policy
Define control, trial configuration and sample criteria

experiments.name: Structure-confirmation interaction
experiments.objective: Isolate one sweep/displacement/structure/FVG confirmation change after earlier interactions are resolved.
experiments.design: Event-linked causal replay with original-decision parity, acceptance and attribution checks.
dependencies: EXP-032 and EXP-033 evidence as relevant
decisions_required: Select exactly one feature or precedence rule
Approve control comparability and outcome criteria

experiments.name: Causal volatility and trend/range segmentation
experiments.objective: Describe pre-entry market regimes without inventing a new trading filter.
experiments.control: PENDING: frozen candidate/control ledgers with sufficient accepted trades
experiments.design: As-of timestamped regime labels with no post-entry leakage; summarize performance and sample sizes by bucket.
decisions_required: Volatility lookback, estimator and bucket boundaries
Trend/range classifier and its as-of availability
Opening session boundaries and missing-data handling
Minimum per-bucket sample sizes and interpretation
